entities.name: Iodocyclopropylpyridine
observations: Heteroaryl iodide substrate is incorporated intact in the product; iodine is retained.
Undergoes oxidation at pyridine nitrogen to form the corresponding N-oxide.

entities.name: Chloroperoxybenzoic acid
observations: Peroxyacid oxidant encoded in the reactants; transfers one oxygen atom to pyridine nitrogen.
Its chlorobenzoic-acid framework is not incorporated into the product.

entities.name: Pyridine N-oxidation
observations: The reaction converts an iodinated cyclopropylpyridine into its zwitterionic pyridine N-oxide.
This is an oxidation rather than a coupling, halogen exchange, or annulation.

entities.name: mCPBA in dichloromethane
observations: Plausible direct conditions are chloroperoxybenzoic acid in dichloromethane, approximately 0 °C to room temperature, followed by aqueous reductive or basic workup.
Alternative oxidants include peracetic acid, activated hydrogen peroxide, or urea-hydrogen peroxide; these are mechanistic alternatives rather than exact-substrate records.
